release_notes:
FocusDefend v3.0.0 — Science Exhibition & Production Master Release:
• Resolved route resolution conflict: added explicit initialRouteName='index' to root Stack to guarantee clean boot directly to landing screen.
• Eliminated update-depth loop and blank screen placeholders in student/parent/teacher/admin layouts with declarative Redirect and branded ActivityIndicator.
• Added global JS error protector (ErrorUtils) preventing unhandled async rejections from terminating the process.
• Full dual-architecture support (arm64-v8a + armeabi-v7a) with official keystore signing (v2/v3 schemes).
